svg.title: S11 and S21 of a 915 MHz band-pass filter, annotated
svg.desc: Simulated S21 and S11 in dB from 700 to 1130 MHz for a three-pole band-pass filter centred on 915 MHz. In the passband S21 is about minus 0.8 dB, which is the insertion loss, and S11 stays below about minus 16 dB, which is the return loss. The minus 3 dB bandwidth is marked between the two points where S21 has fallen 3 dB from its best value. Outside the passband S21 drops steeply: the stopband.
svg.text: Reading a filter plot (example: 3-pole band-pass at 915 MHz)
return loss ≥ 16 dB across the passband
Simulated: 0.1 dB-ripple Chebyshev, 3 resonators, 5% design bandwidth, resonator Q = 350. At 915 MHz S₂₁ = -0.79 dB, S₁₁ = -32 dB.
Power check at 915 MHz: 83.3% transmitted, 0.06% reflected, the rest (16.6%) is heat in the filter.
